profile_text.body:
Richtech Robotics Inc. is listed as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website recorded for the company is rolls-royce.com, and the text harvested from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than Richtech Robotics, so the two sets of facts do not line up.

According to that site, Rolls-Royce describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for the planet's power needs, and as having been at the forefront of innovation for more than 100 years. It says it develops and delivers complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land. The site also reports the completion of a $1 Billion investment in Indiana, a stated intent by Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, cooperation between Rolls-Royce, United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and contractual commitments by Rolls-Royce SMR to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The company has no products, lawsuits, or MCP servers listed, and its law exposure entry for Nevada shows a count of zero.
